jobs.description:
Brandschutzfachfrau/-mann (m/w/d)

80%-100%, Zürich, unbefristet

print
Drucken

Die Abteilung Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SGU) berät, unterstützt und schult sämtliche Organisationseinheiten und Angehörigen der ETH Zürich bei Fragen zu Sicherheit und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz. Sie ist Anlaufstelle für alle zentral zu organisierenden Massnahmen im Umgang mit Gefährdungen und Risiken zum Schutz von Mensch, Tier, Sachwerten, Infrastruktur und Umwelt sowie bei Fragen bezüglich der Erfüllung der entsprechenden gesetzlichen Anforderungen. Für den Ereignisfall unterhält sie eine angemessene Notfallorganisation. Sowohl im Alltag als auch im Ereignisfall arbeitet sie eng mit den Behörden und externen Einsatzkräften zusammen.

Im Bereich Brand- und Explosionsschutz (BEx) verantworten wir die ETH-weite Organisation und Koordination von baulichen, technischen und organisatorischen Massnahmen: dazu gehören beispielsweise die Erarbeitung und Aktualisierung von internen Konzepten, von baulich-technischen Vorgaben und Merkblättern, Federführung oder Mitwirkung bei integralen Sicherheitskonzepten sowie Kontrolle von deren Umsetzung. Zudem sorgen wir für Information und Schulung der ETH-Angehörigen und bringen unsere Fachexpertise bei Bauprojekten ein. Auch die digitale Dokumentation der durchgeführten Qualitätssicherungen gehört zu unseren Aufgaben.

Um diese Aufgaben professionell und effektiv erfüllen zu können, suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, fachkundige und loyale Persönlichkeit auf dem Niveau Brandschutzfachfrau resp. Brandschutzfachmann (m/w/d).

Stellenbeschreibung

Bist Du bereit, in einem motivierten Team Verantwortung für Brand- und Explosionsschutz im Hochschulalltag zu übernehmen? Behältst Du auch im Ereignisfall die Übersicht? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

In dieser vielseitigen Funktion begleitest du Bauprojekte an der ETH Zürich und unterstützt die Akademie, Projektleitende sowie Fachplanende mit deinem fundierten Fachwissen in sämtlichen Brandschutzfragen. Gemeinsam mit Behörden, Fachplanenden und weiteren Anspruchsgruppen entwickelst du praxistaugliche und auf die Bedürfnisse der ETH Zürich abgestimmte Brandschutzlösungen. Dabei prüfst du bestehende und neue Brandschutzkonzepte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und bringst deine Verbesserungsvorschläge proaktiv ein.

Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Brandschutzthemen koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Sektionen innerhalb von SGU bei Bau- und Projektanfragen. Du überprüfst Brandschutzunterlagen wie Konzepte, Brandschutz- und Feuerwehrpläne und koordinierst deren Erstellung sowie laufende Aktualisierung.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit liegt in der Qualitätssicherung und Kontrolle. Du organisierst und führst interne sowie externe feuerpolizeiliche Kontrollen durch, begleitest Bauabnahmen aus Sicht der Bauherrschaft und Eigentümerschaft und stellst die Einhaltung der definierten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsanforderungen sicher. Zudem nimmst du Veranstaltungen ab und sorgst für die konsequente Umsetzung der geltenden Brandschutzauflagen.

Darüber hinaus berätst du die Akademie und den Betrieb in Fragen des Explosionsschutzes sowie beim sicheren Umgang und der fachgerechten Lagerung von Gefahrstoffen, insbesondere brennbaren Flüssigkeiten und Gasen. Du erarbeitest und überprüfst Konzepte, Richtlinien und interne Vorgaben in deinem Fachbereich und trägst damit massgeblich zur Sicherheit an der ETH Zürich bei.

Profil

Ausbildung & Fachkompetenz

• Abschluss im baulichen oder technischen Bereich mit Berufserfahrung

• Abschluss als Brandschutzfachfrau oder Brandschutzfachmann mit eidg. Fachausweis, Eidg. Dipl. Brandschutzexperte:in oder gleichwer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Specialista per la protezione antincendio (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurigo, illimitato

Print Print

Il servizio Sicurezza, Salute e Ambiente (SGU) consiglia, sostiene e forma tutte le unità organizzative e i membri dell'ETH Zurigo su questioni relative alla sicurezza e alla salute sul lavoro. E' il punto di contatto di tutte le misure organizzate a livello centrale per affrontare i rischi per la protezione dell'uomo, degli animali, della proprietà, delle infrastrutture e dell'ambiente nonché per le questioni relative al rispetto dei requisiti giuridici pertinenti.

Nella vita quotidiana e in caso di incidente, lavora a stretto contatto con le autorità e le forze esterne.

Nel campo della protezione antincendio ed esplosione (BEx), siamo responsabili dell'organizzazione e del coordinamento in tutto il sistema ETH delle misure costruttive, tecniche ed organizzative: si tratta, ad esempio, dello sviluppo e dell'aggiornamento di concetti interni, delle specifiche e dei volantini strutturali-tecnici, della guida o della partecipazione nel campo dei concetti di sicurezza antincendio e del controllo della loro attuazione. Forniamo inoltre informazioni e formazione per i membri dell'ETH e contribuiamo alla nostra esperienza nei progetti di costruzione.

I nostri compiti includono la documentazione digitale delle garanzie di qualità svolte.

Per poter svolgere questi compiti in modo professionale ed efficace, siamo alla ricerca di una persona dedicata, esperta e fedele a livello di specialista antincendio (S.F.F.R. (m/f/d)) da subito o su appuntamento.

Descrizione del lavoro

Sei pronto ad assumersi la responsabilità di protezione contro incendi e esplosioni nella vita quotidiana in un team motivato? Tieni una panoramica dell'evento? Allora hai esattamente ragione con noi!

In questa funzione, accompagni i progetti di costruzione di ETH Zurigo e supporti l'accademia, i project manager e i pianificatori tecnici con la tua solida esperienza in tutte le questioni legate alla protezione antincendio. Insieme alle autorità, ai pianificatori specializzati e ad altri stakeholder, sviluppi soluzioni pratiche per la protezione antincendio su misura per le esigenze di ETH Zurigo. Testerai i concetti esistenti e nuovi di protezione antincendio, riconoscerai il potenziale di ottimizzazione e realizzerai proattivamente i tuoi suggerimenti per il miglioramento.

Come persona centrale di contatto per i temi di protezione antincendio, coordina la cooperazione con le varie sezioni all'interno di SGU per le indagini di costruzione e progetto. Si verificano documenti di protezione antincendio come concetti, piani di protezione antincendio e antincendio e coordinare la loro creazione così come aggiornamento in corso.

Un altro punto di riferimento del vostro lavoro è la garanzia della qualità e del controllo. Organizzate ed eseguite controlli interni ed esterni della polizia antincendio, accompagnate i decolli di costruzione dal punto di vista del proprietario e del proprietario dell'edificio e assicurate il rispetto dei requisiti di qualità e sicurezza definiti. Inoltre, prendete eventi e assicurate l'attuazione coerente dei requisiti di protezione antincendio applicabili.

Inoltre consigliate l'Accademia e l'azienda su questioni di protezione contro le esplosioni, manipolazione sicura e stoccaggio adeguato di sostanze pericolose, in particolare liquidi e gas combustibili. Lavorate ed esaminate i concetti, le linee guida e le specifiche interne del vostro reparto e quindi contribuire alla sicurezza presso l'ETH Zurigo.

Profilo

Formazione & competenza

• Laurea in costruzione o in campo tecnico con esperienza professionale

• Laurea in medicina del fuoco o in medicina del fuoco con eidg. Fachaussticht, Eidg. Dipl. Esperto di protezione antincendio:in o simili
descriptionByLocale.en:
Fire protection specialist (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurich, unlimited

Print Print

The Safety, Health and Environment (SGU) department advises, supports and trains all organisational units and members of ETH Zurich on questions concerning safety and health at work. It is the contact point for all centrally organised measures in dealing with risks and risks for the protection of humans, animals, property, infrastructure and the environment as well as for questions regarding the fulfilment of the relevant legal requirements.

In everyday life as well as in the event of an incident, she works closely with the authorities and external forces.

In the field of fire and explosion protection (BEx), we are responsible for the ETH-wide organization and coordination of construction, technical and organizational measures: these include, for example, the development and updating of internal concepts, of structural-technical specifications and leaflets, lead guidance or participation in the field of fire-fighting safety concepts and control of their implementation. We also provide information and training for ETH members and contribute our expertise to construction projects.

Our tasks include digital documentation of the quality assurances carried out.

To be able to perform these tasks professionally and effectively, we are looking for a dedicated, expert and loyal person at the level of fire protection specialist (S.F.F.R. (m/f/d)) by immediately or by appointment.

Job description

Are you ready to take responsibility for fire and explosion protection in everyday life in a motivated team? Do you keep an overview of the event? Then you are exactly right with us!

In this versatile function, you accompany construction projects at ETH Zurich and support the academy, project managers and technical planners with your sound expertise in all fire protection issues. Together with authorities, specialist planners and other stakeholders, you develop practical fire protection solutions that are tailored to the needs of ETH Zurich. You will test existing and new fire protection concepts, recognize optimization potential and proactively implement your suggestions for improvement.

As a central contact person for fire protection topics, you coordinate the cooperation with the various sections within SGU for construction and project inquiries. You check fire protection documents such as concepts, fire protection and fire protection plans and coordinate their creation as well as ongoing updating.

Another focus of your work is on quality assurance and control. You organize and carry out internal and external fire police controls, accompany construction take-offs from the point of view of the building owner and owner and ensure compliance with the defined quality and safety requirements. In addition, you take events and ensure the consistent implementation of the applicable fire protection requirements.

You also advise the Academy and the company on issues of explosion protection, safe handling and the proper storage of hazardous substances, especially combustible liquids and gases. You work and examine concepts, guidelines and internal specifications in your department and thus contribute to safety at ETH Zurich.

Profile

Training & Expertise

• Degree in construction or technical field with professional experience

• Degree as fire protection specialist or fire protection specialist with eidg. Fachaussticht, Eidg. Dipl. Fire protection expert:in or like

Le service de la sécurité, de la santé et de l'environnement (SGU) conseille, soutient et forme toutes les unités organisationnelles et les membres de l'ETH Zurich sur les questions de sécurité et de santé au travail. Il est le point de contact pour toutes les mesures centralisées visant à faire face aux risques et aux risques pour la protection des personnes, des animaux, des biens, des infrastructures et de l'environnement, ainsi que pour les questions relatives au respect des exigences légales pertinentes.

Dans la vie quotidienne comme en cas d'incident, elle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les autorités et les forces extérieures.

Dans le domaine de la protection contre les incendies et les explosions (BEx), nous sommes responsables de l'organisation et de la coordination de la construction à l'échelle de l'ETH, des mesures techniques et organisationnelles, notamment l'élaboration et la mise à jour de concepts internes, de spécifications et de dépliants structuraux et techniques, la direction ou la participation dans le domaine des concepts de sécurité contre les incendies et le contrôle de leur mise en œuvre.

Nos tâches comprennent la documentation numérique des assurances de qualité réalisées.

Pour pouvoir accomplir ces tâches de façon professionnelle et efficace, nous recherchons une personne dévouée, experte et fidèle au niveau de spécialiste de la protection contre l'incendie (S.F.F.R. (h/f/d)) sur rendez-vous ou immédiatement.

Description du poste

Êtes-vous prêt à prendre la responsabilité de la protection contre les incendies et les explosions dans la vie quotidienne dans une équipe motivée? Gardez-vous un aperçu de l'événement? Alors vous avez exactement raison avec nous!

Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous accompagnez des projets de construction à ETH Zurich et accompagnez l'académie, les responsables de projets et les planificateurs techniques avec votre expertise solide dans tous les domaines de la protection contre l'incendie. Avec les autorités, les planificateurs spécialisés et d'autres parties prenantes, vous développez des solutions pratiques de protection contre l'incendie adaptées aux besoins de ETH Zurich.

En tant que personne de contact centrale pour les questions de protection contre l'incendie, vous coordonnez la coopération avec les différentes sections de l'UGS pour les questions de construction et de projet. Vous vérifiez les documents de protection contre l'incendie tels que les concepts, la protection contre l'incendie et les plans de protection contre l'incendie et coordonnez leur création ainsi que la mise à jour continue.

Vous organisez et exécutez des contrôles internes et externes de la police des incendies, accompagnez les décollages de construction du point de vue du propriétaire et du propriétaire du bâtiment et assurez-vous de respecter les exigences de qualité et de sécurité définies. De plus, vous prenez des événements et assurez la mise en œuvre cohérente des exigences de protection contre les incendies applicables.

Vous conseillez également l'Académie et l'entreprise sur les questions de protection contre les explosions, de manipulation sécuritaire et de stockage des substances dangereuses, en particulier les liquides et les gaz de combustible. Vous travaillez et examinez des concepts, des lignes directrices et des spécifications internes dans votre département et contribuez ainsi à la sécurité à l'ETH Zurich.

jobs.description:
Doctoral position in cognitive and moral heuristics in lay people’s reactions to climate change adaptation

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

We are looking for a motivated doctoral student who is interested in applying psychological concepts and methodologies to environmental topics. The position is available starting January 2027.

Project background

While climate change mitigation (e.g., reduction of greenhouse gas emissions) remains important, it is also clear that societies need to adapt to the unavoidable hazards associated with climate change. The recent heat waves in Europe and the health and economical damages they caused, exemplify that adaptation measures are not yet sufficiently in place.

Heuristics (mental shortcuts) can bias people’s risk perceptions and affect moral considerations. As such they can influence people’s private adaptation behaviors and their perceptions of technologies that could help societies to deal better with the consequences of climate change. By influencing regulations, they can also impact the exposure of vulnerable groups to hazards, such as heat.

The aim of this doctoral thesis is to gain insights in how cognitive and moral heuristics influence the effective implementation of climate change adaptation measures.

Job description

• Conceptualization and conduction of empirical studies (quantitative or qualitative designs are possible)

• Writing manuscripts and publishing studies in scientific journals

• Dissemination of research results (e.g., at conferences)

• Supervising bachelor and master students

• Supporting lectures

Profile

• Master’s degree in psychology, environmental science, or social sciences

• Knowledge and first experiences with descriptive and inferential statistics

• Advanced German and English skills

• Ability to think conceptually and work independently

• Strong interest in research and methodologies from psychology and social sciences

We are looking for a motivated doctoral student who is interested in applying psychological concepts and methodologies to environmental topics. The position is available starting January 2027.

Project background

While climate change mitigation (e.g., reduction of greenhouse gas emissions) remains important, it is also clear that societies need to adapt to the unavoidable hazards associated with climate change. The recent heat waves in Europe and the health and economical damages they caused, exemplify that adaptation measures are not yet sufficiently in place.

Heuristics (mental shortcuts) can bias people’s risk perceptions and affect moral considerations. jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Position in Fungal Cell Biology or Biochemistry / Structural Biology of Starship Transposons

100%, Zurich

print
Drucken

The newly established Plant Disease Dynamics group at ETH Zurich is looking to recruit a postdoctoral researcher to study how transposons shape the biology of plant pathogenic fungi. We are looking for someone with prior experience in either fungal cell biology or biochemistry/structural biology , who is excited to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the mobility of Starship transposons and the genes they carry within plant-infecting fungal species. Depending on your background and interests, the position can be shaped toward a cell-biology track (functional and cellular characterisation of transposon mobilisation in living fungal cells) or a biochemistry/structural-biology track (in vitro reconstitution and structural characterisation of the proteins that drive Starship activity).

This position forms one of three pillars of a collaborative, interdisciplinary research project. A fungal genomics expert has already been recruited to lead the comparative genomics pillar, mining natural fungal populations for the diversity and evolutionary history of Starship transposons. This new position will partner closely with that colleague, contributing either the cell-biology or the biochemistry/structural-biology perspective needed to move from population-level patterns to mechanistic, experimentally validated models of how Starship transposons move and integrate their cargo.

Project background

Horizontal gene transfer (HGT) enables the spread of pathogenicity genes between microbes and can therefore drive the emergence of novel diseases. In pathogenic fungi, an emerging global threat to both humans and our crops, the mechanisms that facilitate HGT remain unknown. Recent work has uncovered a novel group of giant transposons called Starships, which have moved virulence, metal tolerance and other fitness-associated genes horizontally between fungal species.

This project is focused on the plant pathogenic fungi Bipolaris sorokiniana, Parastagonospora nodorum and Pyrenophora tritici-repentis, which all carry the fungal virulence gene ToxA, nested inside a smaller passenger transposon called ToxTA. This transposon has been captured independently by two different Starship transposons, Sanctuary and Horizon, with evidence of other captures in other fungal species. While the genomics pillar reconstructs the evolutionary history of ToxTA across natural fungal populations, this position will get at the underlying mechanism directly: either by studying, in living fungal cells, how Starships and their passenger transposons move and are regulated, or by biochemically and structurally characterising the proteins that carry out capture, excision and integration. Together, the two approaches aim to identify which genetic and molecular features are essential for horizontal transfer.

Job description

• Investigate the molecular mechanisms driving Starship transposon mobility and cargo capture, using an approach suited to your specialty:

• Cell biology track: develop and apply cellular and functional assays (e.g. confocal, single-cell sorting, membrane biology) to track Starship activity and passenger-gene mobilisation within living fungal cells

• Biochemistry/structural biology track: express, purify and biochemically characterise Starship-encoded proteins (e.g. the Captain tyrosine recombinase and associated factors), and determine their structures to reveal how they recognise and mobilise cargo DNA

• Establish and optimise experimental model systems for studying Starship transposon activity in the lab

• Work closely with the lab's genomics postdoc to connect population-level patterns with mechanistic findings

• Proactively manage the relevant experimental data and resources for your track

• Supervise and mentor PhD and Masters students

• Assist in the delivery of lectures or seminars for the Plant

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione post-dottorale in biologia delle cellule fungine o biochimica / Biologia strutturale delle transposizioni di Starship

100%, Zurigo

stampa
Druppo

Il nuovo gruppo Plant Disease Dynamics dell'ETH di Zurigo sta cercando di reclutare un ricercatore post-dottorato per studiare come i trasposoni modellano la biologia dei funghi patogeni vegetali. Stiamo cercando qualcuno con esperienza precedente in biologia delle cellule fungine o biochimica/biologia strutturale, che è entusiasta di indagare i meccanismi molecolari alla base della mobilità dei transpositivi di Starship e dei geni che trasportano all'interno delle specie fungine infettanti dalle piante. A seconda del tuo background e degli interessi, la posizione può essere modellata verso una traccia di biologia cellulare (carattere funzionale e cellulare della mobilitazione transposon nelle cellule fungine viventi) o una traccia di biochimica/strutturale-biologia (in vitro ricostituzione e caratterizzazione strutturale delle proteine che guidano l'attività di Starship).

Questa posizione costituisce uno dei tre pilastri di un progetto di ricerca collaborativo e interdisciplinare. Un esperto di genomica fungina è già stato reclutato per guidare il pilastro della genomica comparativa, estraendo le popolazioni naturali fungine per la diversità e la storia evolutiva dei trasposoni di Starship. Questa nuova posizione si adopererà a stretto contatto con quel collega, contribuendo sia alla biologia cellulare che alla prospettiva biochimica/strutturale-biologia necessaria per passare dai modelli a livello di popolazione ai modelli meccanicistici, sperimentalmente convalidati di come i transpositivi di Starship si muovono e integrano il loro carico.

Sfondo del progetto

Il trasferimento genico orizzontale (HGT) consente la diffusione di geni patogeni tra i microbi e può quindi guidare l'emergere di nuove malattie. Nei funghi patogeni, una minaccia globale emergente sia per gli esseri umani che per le colture, i meccanismi che facilitano la HGT rimangono sconosciuti. Recenti lavori hanno scoperto un nuovo gruppo di transponti giganti chiamati Starships, che hanno mosso virulence, la tolleranza dei metalli e altri geni associati al fitness orizzontalmente tra le specie fungine.

Questo progetto è focalizzato sui funghi patogeni vegetali Bipolaris sorokiniana, Parastagonospora nodorum e Pyrenophora tritici-repentis, che trasportano tutti il gene fungine di virulenza ToxA, annidato all'interno di un transposon passeggeri più piccolo chiamato ToxTA. Questo transposon è stato catturato in modo indipendente da due diversi trasposoni di Starship, Sanctuary e Horizon, con la prova di altre cattura in altre specie fungine. Mentre il pilastro della genomica ricostruisce la storia evolutiva del ToxTA attraverso le popolazioni fungine naturali, questa posizione otterrà direttamente al meccanismo sottostante: sia studiando, in cellule fungine viventi, come le Stelle e i loro transpositivi passeggeri si muovono e sono regolati, o caratterizzando biochimicamente e strutturalmente le proteine che effettuano la cattura, l'escisione e l'integrazione. Insieme, i due approcci mirano a identificare quali caratteristiche genetiche e molecolari sono essenziali per il trasferimento orizzontale.

Descrizione del lavoro

• Indagare i meccanismi molecolari che guidano la mobilità e la cattura di carichi traspositivi di Starship, utilizzando un approccio adatto alla vostra specialità:

• Traccia di biologia cellulare: sviluppare e applicare saggi cellulari e funzionali (ad es. confocali, smistamento monocellulare, biologia della membrana) per monitorare l'attività di Starship e la mobilizzazione del genere passeggeri all'interno delle cellule fungine viventi

• Traccia di biochimica/biologia strutturale: esplicita, purifica e biochimicamente caratterizzata da proteine codificate a stella (ad es. la recombinasi della tirosina del capitano e fattori associati), e determinare le loro strutture per rivelare come riconoscono e mobilizzano il DNA del carico

• Stabilire e ottimizzare i sistemi di modelli sperimentali per studiare l'attività di transposon di Starship in laboratorio

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la genomica del laboratorio postdoc per collegare modelli a livello di popolazione con risultati meccanicistici

• Gestione attiva dei dati e delle risorse sperimentali rilevanti per la tua traccia

• Supervisione e mentore dottorandi e master studenti

• Assistere nella consegna di conferenze o seminari per l'impianto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Postdoc-Position in der Pilzzellbiologie oder Biochemie / Strukturbiologie von Raumschiff-Transposons

100%, Zürich

Druck
Druckerzeugnisse

Die neu gegründete Gruppe Plant Disease Dynamics an der ETH Zürich will einen Postdoktoranden rekrutieren, um zu untersuchen, wie Transposons die Biologie pflanzenpathogener Pilze prägen. Wir suchen jemanden mit vorheriger Erfahrung in der Pilzzellbiologie oder der Biochemie / Strukturbiologie, der sich darauf freut, die molekularen Mechanismen zu untersuchen, die der Mobilität von Raumschiff-Transposonen und den Genen zugrunde liegen, die sie in pflanzeninfizierenden Pilzarten tragen. Abhängig von Ihrem Hintergrund und Ihren Interessen kann die Position in Richtung einer zellbiologischen Spur (funktionelle und zelluläre Charakterisierung der Transposonmobilisierung in lebenden Pilzzellen) oder einer biochemischen/strukturbiologischen Spur (in vitro Rekonstitution und strukturelle Charakterisierung der Proteine, die die Starship-Aktivität vorantreiben) geformt werden.

Diese Position bildet eine von drei Säulen eines kollaborativen, interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekts. Ein Experte für Pilzgenomik wurde bereits rekrutiert, um die Säule der vergleichenden Genomik zu leiten und natürliche Pilzpopulationen für die Vielfalt und Evolutionsgeschichte von Raumschiff-Transposonen abzubauen. Diese neue Position wird eng mit diesem Kollegen zusammenarbeiten und entweder die Zellbiologie oder die Biochemie / Strukturbiologie-Perspektive beitragen, die erforderlich ist, um von Mustern auf Populationsebene zu mechanistischen, experimentell validierten Modellen zu gelangen, wie sich Raumschiff-Transposons bewegen und ihre Ladung integrieren.

Projekthintergrund

Horizontaler Gentransfer (HGT) ermöglicht die Verbreitung von Pathogenitätsgenen zwischen Mikroben und kann daher die Entstehung neuer Krankheiten vorantreiben. Bei pathogenen Pilzen, einer sich abzeichnenden globalen Bedrohung sowohl für den Menschen als auch für unsere Kulturen, bleiben die Mechanismen, die die HGT erleichtern, unbekannt. Jüngste Arbeiten haben eine neue Gruppe von riesigen Transposonen namens Starships aufgedeckt, die Virulenz, Metalltoleranz und andere Fitness-assoziierte Gene horizontal zwischen Pilzarten bewegt haben.

Dieses Projekt konzentriert sich auf die pflanzenpathogenen Pilze Bipolaris sorokiniana, Parastagonospora nodorum und Pyrenophora tritici-repentis, die alle das Pilzvirulenzgen ToxA tragen, das in einem kleineren Passagiertransposon namens ToxTA eingebettet ist. Dieses Transposon wurde unabhängig voneinander von zwei verschiedenen Sternenschiff-Transposonen, Sanctuary und Horizon, mit Beweisen für andere Einfänge in anderen Pilzarten gefangen genommen. Während die Genomik-Säule die Evolutionsgeschichte von ToxTA in natürlichen Pilzpopulationen rekonstruiert, wird diese Position direkt zum zugrunde liegenden Mechanismus gelangen: Entweder indem in lebenden Pilzzellen untersucht wird, wie sich Raumschiffe und ihre Passagier-Transposons bewegen und reguliert werden, oder indem die Proteine, die Einfang, Exzision und Integration durchführen, biochemisch und strukturell charakterisiert werden. Gemeinsam zielen die beiden Ansätze darauf ab, zu identifizieren, welche genetischen und molekularen Merkmale für den horizontalen Transfer wesentlich sind.

Stellenbeschreibung

• Untersuchen Sie die molekularen Mechanismen, die die Mobilität von Raumschiff-Transposonen und die Ladungserfassung antreiben, mit einem Ansatz, der für Ihre Spezialität geeignet ist:

• Zellbiologie: Entwicklung und Anwendung zellulärer und funktioneller Assays (z. B. konfokale, Einzelzellsortierung, Membranbiologie) zur Verfolgung der Aktivität von Raumschiffen und der Mobilisierung von Passagiergenen in lebenden Pilzzellen

• Biochemie/Strukturbiologie: exprimieren, reinigen und biochemisch charakterisieren Starship-kodierte Proteine (z. B. Captain Tyrosin-Rekombinase und assoziierte Faktoren) und bestimmen ihre Strukturen, um zu zeigen, wie sie Fracht-DNA erkennen und mobilisieren

• Etablieren und Optimieren von experimentellen Modellsystemen zur Untersuchung der Transposonaktivität von Sternenschiffen im Labor

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Genom-Postdoc des Labors zusammen, um Muster auf Populationsebene mit mechanistischen Erkenntnissen zu verbinden

• Verwalten Sie proaktiv die relevanten experimentellen Daten und Ressourcen für Ihren Track

• Beaufsichtigen und Mentor PhD und Masters Studenten

• Unterstützung bei der Bereitstellung von Vorträgen oder Seminaren für die Anlage
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Position postdoctorale en biologie des cellules fongiques ou biochimie / Biologie structurale des transposons de vaisseaux stellaires

100 %, Zurich

imprimer
Purée

Le groupe de dynamique des maladies des plantes nouvellement créé à l'ETH Zurich cherche à recruter un chercheur postdoctoral pour étudier comment les transposons façonnent la biologie des champignons pathogènes des plantes. Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne ayant une expérience antérieure en biologie des cellules fongiques ou en biochimie/biologie structurale, qui est impatiente d'étudier les mécanismes moléculaires sous-jacents à la mobilité des transposons de vaisseau et les gènes qu'ils portent au sein des espèces fongiques infectées par les plantes. Selon vos antécédents et vos intérêts, la position peut être façonnée vers une piste cellulaire-biologie (caractérisation fonctionnelle et cellulaire de la mobilisation transposon dans les cellules fongiques vivantes) ou une piste biochimie/structurel-biologie (reconstitution in vitro et caractérisation structurelle des protéines qui animent l'activité Starship).

Ce poste constitue l'un des trois piliers d'un projet de recherche interdisciplinaire et collaboratif. Un expert en génomique fongique a déjà été recruté pour diriger le pilier de génomique comparative, l'exploitation des populations de champignons naturels pour la diversité et l'histoire évolutionnaire des transposons de vaisseau. Ce nouveau poste s'associera étroitement avec ce collègue, contribuant soit à la biologie cellulaire, soit à la perspective biochimie/structure-biologie nécessaire pour passer des modèles au niveau de la population à des modèles mécanistes, validés expérimentalement, de la façon dont les transposons de vaisseau stellaire se déplacent et intègrent leur cargaison.

Contexte du projet

Le transfert horizontal de gènes (HGT) permet la propagation de gènes de pathogénicité entre microbes et peut donc provoquer l'émergence de nouvelles maladies. Chez les champignons pathogènes, une menace mondiale émergente pour les humains et nos cultures, les mécanismes qui facilitent l'HGT demeurent inconnus. Des travaux récents ont révélé un nouveau groupe de transposons géants appelés Starships, qui ont déplacé horizontalement la virulence, la tolérance aux métaux et d'autres gènes associés à la condition physique entre les espèces fongiques.

Ce projet est axé sur les champignons phytopathogènes Bipolaris sorokiniana, Parastagonospora nodorum et Pyrenophora tritici-repentis, qui portent tous le gène de virulence fongique ToxA, niché dans un petit transposon passager appelé ToxTA. Ce transposon a été capturé indépendamment par deux transposons de vaisseau, Sanctuaire et Horizon, avec des preuves d'autres captures chez d'autres espèces fongiques. Alors que le pilier génomique reconstitue l'histoire évolutive de ToxTA à travers les populations fongiques naturelles, cette position s'approchera directement du mécanisme sous-jacent : soit en étudiant, dans les cellules fongiques vivantes, comment Starships et leurs transposons passagers se déplacent et sont régulés, soit en caractérisant biochimiquement et structurellement les protéines qui effectuent capture, excision et intégration. Ensemble, les deux approches visent à déterminer quelles caractéristiques génétiques et moléculaires sont essentielles au transfert horizontal.

Description de l'emploi

• Étudier les mécanismes moléculaires qui conduisent la mobilité et la capture des cargaisons de Starship, en utilisant une approche adaptée à votre spécialité:

• Voie de biologie cellulaire : élaborer et appliquer des tests cellulaires et fonctionnels (p. ex., tri confocal, monocellulaire, biologie membranaire) pour suivre l'activité des vaisseaux stellaires et la mobilisation passagers-gènes au sein des cellules fongiques vivantes

• Voie biochimie/biologie structurale : exprimer, purifier et caractériser biochimiquement les protéines codées par vaisseau stellaire (p. ex. la recombinase de tyrosine capitaine et les facteurs associés) et déterminer leurs structures pour révéler comment elles reconnaissent et mobilisent l'ADN de la cargaison

• Établir et optimiser des systèmes de modèles expérimentaux pour l'étude de l'activité transposon de Starship en laboratoire

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la génomique postdoc du laboratoire pour établir un lien entre les modèles de population et les résultats mécanistes

• Gérer proactivement les données et ressources expérimentales pertinentes pour votre piste

• Superviser et mentorer les étudiants en doctorat et en maîtrise

• Aider à donner des conférences ou des séminaires pour la plante

Das Departement Architektur (D-ARCH) der ETH Zürich ist mit rund 2’500 Studierenden und über 40 Professuren die grösste Architekturausbildungsstätte der Schweiz und gehört zu den führenden Architekturschulen weltweit.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n:

Programmkoordinator/in (m/w/d) für die Studienprogramme in Architektur mit einem Arbeitspensum von 80–100%.

Stellenbeschreibung

• Sie arbeiten partnerschaftlich eng zusammen und vertreten gemeinsam mit der Studienkoordinatorin die Studiengänge des Departements administrativ nach innen und aussen, namentlich gegenüber den zentralen ETH-Stellen, insbesondere dem Rektorat und den Akademischen Diensten. Sie sind Teil entsprechender Netzwerke.

• Sie stellen die gesamtdepartementale Koordination aller Studienprogramme sicher; insbesondere verantworten Sie die Planungs- und Koordinationsprozesse betreffend die Architekturstudiengänge (BSc/MSc ETH ARCH), insbesondere auch die Koordination des Semesterstundenplanes der beiden Programme in Absprache mit der zentralen Stundenplankoordination.

• Sie sind zentrale Ansprechperson für Professuren, Dozierende/Lehrbeauftragte, sowie die Koordinatorinnen und Koordinatoren der übrigen Studienprogramme und der Doktoratsprogramme des Departements.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit der Departementsleitung zusammen, insbesondere mit der Studiendirektorin/dem Studiendirektor BSc/MSc ARCH und – für Themen rund um das Doktorat und die Weiterbildung – mit der Forschungsdirektorin/dem Forschungsdirektor.

• Sie beraten die Studiendirektorin/den Studiendirektor BSc/MSc ARCH, sowohl strategisch als auch konzeptionell, und arbeiten aktiv mit bei der Weiterentwicklung und nationalen/internationalen Positionierung der Architekturstudiengänge (BSc/MSc ETH ARCH).

• Sie begleiten periodische Programmevaluationen sowie Revisionen der studienbezogenen Reglemente.

• Sie führen die Geschäfte der Unterrichtskommission, und unterstützen die Zulassungsprozesse sowie Anpassungen im laufenden Lehrangebot.

• Sie konzipieren, planen und organisieren die Informations- und Einführungsveranstaltungen für Studieninteressierte und neueintretende Studierende.

• Sie bereiten auf und analysieren die relevanten lehrbezogenen Daten und Erstellen Planungs- und Entscheidungsgrundlagen sowie zielgruppengerechte Kommunikationsmaterialien.

• Praktikumskoordination: Sie verantworten die Koordination und Weiterentwicklung des Praktikumsprogramms im Architekturstudium zusammen mit dem Institut der Architektur und Entwurf. Dazu gehören die Prüfung und Genehmigung von Praktikumsvereinbarungen, die Sicherstellung einer regelkonformen Kreditpunktevergabe, die Betreuung der Reflexionsberichte sowie die Durchführung von Qualitätssicherungsmassnahmen. Zudem pflegen Sie die Praktikumsplattform als Wissensarchiv und entwickeln das Netzwerk zu Praxispartnern und anerkannten Praktikumsstellen kontinuierlich weiter.

Profil

Wir suchen eine strategisch denkende und operativ starke Persönlichkeit für diese Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle von Lehre, Administration und akademischer Governance. Die Position vereint Führungsverantwortung, Studiengangsentwicklung sowie komplexe Koordinations- und Beratungsaufgaben im Hochschulumfeld.

• Sie verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungskompetenz, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, auch in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld verbindlich aufzutreten und konsensfähige Lösungen herbeizuführen.

• Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss, Berufserfahrung, ergänzende Weiterbildung oder Promotion sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

• Sie verfügen über ein vertieftes Verständnis akademischer

Conservatore degli animali: in EFZ (m/f/d) 2027 - animali sperimentali

Zurigo, posizione didattica

Stampa

Vuoi fare un apprendistato sostenibile? Sei curioso, cosmopolita, vuoi fare la differenza e crescere personalmente allo stesso tempo? Vuoi essere sul polso del tempo? Allora siete esattamente al ETH di Zurigo, perché è qui che sorge il futuro.

Descrizione del lavoro

L'insegnamento ottimale per i giovani adulti con un knack per gli animali e l'interesse per la ricerca!

In questo vario insegnamento si tratta delle seguenti attività:

• Cura, cura e allevamento di animali sperimentali, compresi i cambiamenti di gabbia, alimentazione e acqua e il monitoraggio giornaliero della salute

• Organizzazione e attuazione del trasporto interno ed esterno di animali, compreso il controllo dei documenti di consegna e igiene

• Assunzione di campioni (sangue, feci, urina, tessuto) e realizzazione di applicazioni nel quadro di esperimenti

• Garantire il benessere degli animali in collaborazione con il benessere degli animali e i servizi veterinari

• Documentazione degli animali di prova, lavori effettuati e possibili rapporti di malattia secondo le linee guida per il benessere degli animali

L'allenamento dura 3 anni e si svolge principalmente nel campus Hönggerberg dell'ETH e in una società partner sull'Irchel.

Profilo

Siete abili nel trattare con gli animali e avere la sensibilità necessaria nella vostra cura e atteggiamento. Inoltre, avete una buona potenza di osservazione, sono attenti, pazienti, affidabili e responsabili. Inoltre, si è fisicamente resiliente e hanno una capacità motoria.

Per questo apprendistato professionale è necessario una laurea obbligatoria e una buona prestazione nelle seguenti materie scolastiche:

• Biologia

• Inglese

Luogo di lavoro

Offriamo

• Settimane introduttive all'inizio dell'insegnamento con tutti i nuovi studenti dell'ETH di Zurigo

• Sei settimane di vacanze all'anno

• Infrastrutture moderne e sostegno professionale durante il periodo di apprendistato

• Eventi e workshop regolari per lo sviluppo personale e il networking con altri studenti

• Gratis, vasta gamma di sport nell'ASVZ

chevron destra
Lavoro, insegnamento e ricerca presso l'ETH di Zurigo

La diversità e la sostenibilità sono importanti per noi

In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich supporta una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo pari opportunità, la diversità del valore e coltiviamo un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento che rispetta i diritti e la dignità di tutti i dipendenti e gli studenti. Sul nostro sito web su pari opportunità e diversità, imparerai come garantiamo un ambiente equo e aperto in cui tutti possono svilupparsi e prosperare. La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi – stiamo costantemente lavorando verso un futuro neutro dal clima.

Curioso? Anche noi.

Nota:

Al fine di aumentare le pari opportunità per i nostri candidati, non abbiamo bisogno di una lettera di motivazione, di una foto o di un semplice/multicheck. Non consideriamo questi documenti, se li presenti comunque.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online con i seguenti documenti:

• CV (senza foto)

• Copie di tutti i certificati della scuola superiore, del 10. Anno scolastico o liceo

• Interlock 8 o Controlla S2

• Conferma della lezione di prova

• Certificati, Conferma dei Corsi / Impegno per il tempo libero (se disponibile)

Per ulteriori informazioni, il team di formazione professionale è a vostra disposizione per telefono +41 (0)44 632 89 33. Ulteriori informazioni sulla formazione professionale di ETH Zurich possono essere trovate nel nostro film o sul nostro sito web.

Informazioni su ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich è una delle migliori università di scienze tecniche del mondo. Siamo conosciuti per il nostro eccellente insegnamento, ricerca di base innovativa

Animal keeper:in EFZ (m/f/d) 2027 - experimental animals

Zurich, teaching position

Printing

Do you want to do a sustainable apprenticeship? You are curious, cosmopolitan, want to make a difference and grow personally at the same time? Want to be on the pulse of time? Then you are exactly right at ETH Zurich, because this is where the future arises.

Job description

The optimal teaching for young adults with a knack for animals and interest in research!

In this varied teaching you deal with the following activities:

• Care, care and breeding of experimental animals including cage, feed and water changes and daily health monitoring

• Organisation and implementation of internal and external animal transport including control of delivery and hygiene documents

• Taking of samples (blood, faeces, urine, tissue) and carrying out applications within the framework of experiments

• Ensuring animal welfare in cooperation with animal welfare and veterinary services

• Documentation of the test animals, work carried out and possible disease reports according to animal welfare guidelines

The training lasts 3 years and takes place mainly on the Hönggerberg campus of the ETH and in a partner company on the Irchel.

Profile

You are skilled in dealing with animals and have the necessary sensitivity in your care and attitude. In addition, you have a good power of observation, are attentive, patient, reliable and responsible. Furthermore, you are physically resilient and have a motor skill.

For this vocational apprenticeship you need a mandatory school degree and good performance in the following school subjects:

• Biology

• English

Place of work

We offer

• Introductory weeks at the beginning of teaching with all new learners at ETH Zurich

• Six weeks of holidays per year

• Modern infrastructure and professional support throughout the apprenticeship period

• Regular events and workshops for personal development and networking with other learners

• Free, wide range of sports in the ASVZ

chevron right
Working, teaching and researching at ETH Zurich

Diversity and sustainability are important to us

In line with our values, ETH Zurich supports an inclusive culture. We promote equal opportunities, value diversity and cultivate a working and learning environment that respects the rights and dignity of all employees and students. On our website on equal opportunities and diversity, you will learn how we ensure a fair and open environment in which everyone can develop and flourish. Sustainability is a key value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

Curious? We are too.

Note:

In order to increase equal opportunities for our applicants, we do not require a letter of motivation, a photo or a basic/multicheck. We do not consider these documents, should you submit them anyway.

We look forward to your online application with the following documents:

• CV (without photo)

• Copies of all upper school certificates, of the 10. School year or high school

• Interlock 8 or Check S2

• Test lesson confirmations

• Certificates, Confirmations of Courses / Leisure Engagement (if available)

For further information, the vocational training team is at your disposal by telephone +41 (0)44 632 89 33. Additional information about the vocational training of ETH Zurich can be found in our film or on our website.

About ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich is one of the best technical science universities in the world. We are known for our excellent teaching, groundbreaking basic research

jobs.description:
Scientific Assistant - PRISM

20%-40%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

About the Project

PRISM is an ETH Innovedum research and teaching project based at the Chair of Prof. Jan De Vylder (D-ARCH). The project develops AI-assisted tools for architectural drawing archiving, analysis, and teaching integration. It runs from Autumn 2026 to April 2028 and is partially funded by ETH Innovedum.

The Role

We are looking for a motivated and curious architect to join the PRISM project as a Scientific / Research Assistant. You will take on a central role in the project, working across architectural content, digital tools, and AI-supported processes.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of architectural drawing culture and emerging digital methods. You will collaborate closely with the project leads Jan De Vylder, Angélique Kuenzle and Johanna Roth, and work alongside a student assistant.

Employment Conditions

• Duration: approx. 1 year – starting October 1, 2026

• Workload: 20 - 40%

• Location: ETH Zürich, D-ARCH

• Salary: according to ETH guidelines for scientific staff

Job description

• Support drawing archiving and digitisation processes

• Assist in AI model training and image labelling

• Contribute to database build-up, full stack application development, and UX/UI implementation

• Help set up and maintain ETH digital infrastructure

• Participate in project coordination, documentation, and communication

• Contribute to the integration of project outcomes into studio teaching

• Application experience in funding for bigger grants

Profile

• Background in architecture, with a strong interest in drawing, spatial representation, and chair culture

• Genuine curiosity about AI tools and digital methods in an architectural context

• Experience with Python programming, modern web development and AI coding agents; experience with cloud deployment is a plus

• Structured, reliable, and able to work independently within a small team

• Good communication skills in English (German a plus)

Workplace

We offer

• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

• A short letter of motivation

• CV

• A selection of relevant work (portfolio, please also indicate if you have done a studio in our chair)

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Position: Interdisciplinary coordination of "Storylines of climate extreme events"

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

We invite applications for an interdisciplinary coordination position on climate adaptation to extreme events under the supervision of Prof. Sonia I. Seneviratne and Prof. David Bresch (ETH Zurich). The position will be part of the NCCR CLIM+ programme ( www.nccr-climplus.ch ) and the NCCR CLIM+ Management Center at ETH Zurich.

Project background

NCCR CLIM+ supports Switzerland in the transformation towards a climate-resilient society. Together with stakeholders, the interdisciplinary NCCR CLIM+ research community tackles unexplored solution spaces to the climate crisis and develops a blueprint for actionable climate research worldwide. NCCR CLIM+ broadly communicates and shares knowledge and trains a new generation of experts with the necessary domain and transdisciplinary knowledge.

Job description

In NCCR CLIM+, storylines are used to work inter- and transdisciplinarily to develop (adaptation and mitigation) solutions to changes in climate extremes. While individual storylines target adaptation to a specific type of extreme event, it is important to ensure the exchange of inter- and transdisciplinary learnings across storylines.

We seek a researcher to support the coordination and integration across several storylines (Financial stability and supply chains; Heat and health; Climate tipping points and abrupt changes). In this role, you will be a natural science and inter-/transdisciplinary research expert in a team with natural scientists, social scientists and transdisciplinary researchers and you will support the choice of methods for science and transdisciplinary integration.

You will be part of the NCCR CLIM+ programme and benefit from its extensive exchange and training in inter- and transdisciplinary research. You will publish your results in scientific journals and present them at national and international conferences.

The first phase of this position is planned for a duration of 3.5 years, starting on November 1 2026 or upon agreement. The contract term is one year at a time, with the option of renewal. The salary follows ETH Zurich regulations. A part-time employment (e.g. 80%) can be considered in cases of child- or family care, or other projects or employment.

Profile

You hold a PhD degree in climate science, environmental sciences, meteorology, or a closely related field. You have experience in either inter- or transdisciplinary research and are keen to fully engage in both. You are motivated to co-develop the necessary tools and platforms for exchange. Experience with climate modeling and the processing of climate model data, climate attribution and climate projections, as well as with financial and health impacts of climate change, and/or global climate tipping points is an asset. We encourage applications from enthusiastic and dedicated individuals with very good oral and written English communication skills. Command of one of the Swiss national languages is desired. The position can be filled at junior or senior postdoctoral level. This position is particularly attractive for postdoctoral researchers aiming for a career at the interface between climate science, policy and society, and who wish to take on coordination responsibilities.

Workplace

We offer

• A job with impact : NCCR CLIM+ supports your professional development and contributes to positive change in society

• Flexible working conditions in an inspiring, international research environment

• Varied tasks at the interface of science, policy and society

• An engaged and supportive team

• Conferences, workshops and training opportunities

• Opportunities to expand your network and gain valuable experience in academic leadership and project development

Invitiamo le domande per una posizione di coordinamento interdisciplinare sull'adattamento climatico ad eventi estremi sotto la supervisione del Prof. Sonia I. Seneviratne e il Prof. David Bresch (ETH Zurich). La posizione sarà parte del programma NCCR CLIM+ (www.nccr-climplus.ch) e del NCCR CLIM+ Centro di gestione dell'ETH di Zurigo.

Sfondo del progetto

NCCR CLIM+ sostiene la Svizzera nella trasformazione verso una società responsabile del clima. Insieme con le parti interessate, la comunità interdisciplinare di ricerca NCCR CLIM+ affronta spazi di soluzione inesplorati alla crisi del clima e sviluppa un progetto per la ricerca a livello mondiale. NCCR CLIM+ comunica e condivide la conoscenza e forma una nuova generazione di esperti con il dominio necessario e la conoscenza transdisciplinare.

Descrizione del lavoro

In NCCR CLIM+, le storie sono utilizzate per lavorare in modo interdisciplinare e transdisciplinare per sviluppare (adaptazione e mitigazione) soluzioni ai cambiamenti negli estremi climatici. Mentre le storie individuali mirano all'adattamento a un tipo specifico di evento estremo, è importante garantire lo scambio di apprendimento interdisciplinare e transdisciplinare attraverso storie.

Cerchiamo un ricercatore per sostenere il coordinamento e l'integrazione in diversi storyline (stabilità finanziaria e filiere; Calore e salute; punti di ribaltamento del clima e brutti cambiamenti). In questo ruolo, sarai una scienza naturale e un esperto di ricerca inter-/transdisciplinare in un team con scienziati naturali, scienziati sociali e ricercatori transdisciplinari e supporterai la scelta dei metodi per la scienza e l'integrazione transdisciplinare.

Sarete parte del programma NCCR CLIM+ e beneficiare del suo ampio scambio e formazione nella ricerca interdisciplinare e transdisciplinare. Pubblicherai i tuoi risultati in riviste scientifiche e li presenterai a conferenze nazionali e internazionali.

La prima fase di questa posizione è prevista per una durata di 3,5 anni, a partire dal 1 ° novembre 2026 o su accordo. Il termine contrattuale è di un anno alla volta, con l'opzione di rinnovo. Lo stipendio segue la normativa ETH Zurich. Un'occupazione part-time (ad esempio l'80%) può essere considerata in caso di assistenza per bambini o familiari, o in altri progetti o occupazione.

Profilo

Hai una laurea in scienze del clima, scienze ambientali, meteorologia, o un campo strettamente correlato. Avete esperienza nella ricerca interdisciplinare o transdisciplinare e siete desiderosi di impegnarsi pienamente in entrambi. Siete motivati a co-sviluppare gli strumenti e le piattaforme necessarie per lo scambio. L'esperienza con la modellazione del clima e il trattamento dei dati del modello climatico, l'attribuzione del clima e le proiezioni del clima, così come con gli impatti finanziari e sanitari del cambiamento climatico, e/o punti di ribaltamento del clima globale è un bene. Incoraggiamo applicazioni da persone entusiaste e dedicate con ottime capacità di comunicazione inglese orale e scritta. Si desidera il comando di una delle lingue nazionali svizzere. La posizione può essere riempita a livello post-dottorato junior o senior. Questa posizione è particolarmente attraente per i ricercatori post-dottoriali che mirano a una carriera nell'interfaccia tra scienza del clima, politica e società, e che desiderano assumere responsabilità di coordinamento.

You will be part of the NCCR CLIM+ programme and benefit from its extensive exchange and training in inter- and transdisciplinary research. You will publish your results in scientific journals and present them at national and international conferences.

The first phase of this position is planned for a duration of 3.5 years, starting on November 1 2026 or upon agreement. The contract term is one year at a time, with the option of renewal. The salary follows ETH Zurich regulations. A part-time employment (e.g. 80%) can be considered in cases of child- or family care, or other projects or employment.

Profile

You hold a PhD degree in climate science, environmental sciences, meteorology, or a closely related field. You have experience in either inter- or transdisciplinary research and are keen to fully engage in both. You are motivated to co-develop the necessary tools and platforms for exchange. Experience with climate modeling and the processing of climate model data, climate attribution and climate projections, as well as with financial and health impacts of climate change, and/or global climate tipping points is an asset. We encourage applications from enthusiastic and dedicated individuals with very good oral and written English communication skills. Command of one of the Swiss national languages is desired. The position can be filled at junior or senior postdoctoral level. This position is particularly attractive for postdoctoral researchers aiming for a career at the interface between climate science, policy and society, and who wish to take on coordination responsibilities.

Workplace

We offer

• A job with impact : NCCR CLIM+ supports your professional development and contributes to positive change in society

• Flexible working conditions in an inspiring, international research environment

• Varied tasks at the interface of science, policy and society

• An engaged and supportive team

• Conferences, workshops and training opportunities

• Opportunities to expand your network and gain valuable experience in academic leadership and project development

Position postdoctorale: Coordination interdisciplinaire des «Lignes d'histoire des événements climatiques extrêmes»

100%, Zurich, durée déterminée

imprimer
Purée

Nous invitons les candidatures à une position de coordination interdisciplinaire sur l'adaptation climatique aux événements extrêmes sous la supervision du Prof. Sonia I. Seneviratne et le Prof. David Bresch (ETH Zurich). Ce poste fera partie du programme NCCR CLIM+ ( www.nccr-climplus.ch ) et du NCCR CLIM+ Centre de gestion de l'ETH Zurich.

Contexte du projet

NCCR CLIM+ soutient la Suisse dans sa transformation vers une société résiliente au climat. En collaboration avec les parties prenantes, la communauté de recherche interdisciplinaire NCCR CLIM+ s'attaque aux espaces de solutions inexplorés à la crise climatique et élabore un plan de recherche sur le climat réalisable dans le monde entier. Le CCNR CLIM+ communique et partage largement ses connaissances et forme une nouvelle génération d'experts possédant le domaine et les connaissances transdisciplinaires nécessaires.

Description de l'emploi

Dans le NCCR CLIM+, les storylines sont utilisées pour travailler inter- et transdisciplinairement pour développer (adaptation et atténuation) des solutions aux changements des extrêmes climatiques. Alors que les narrations individuelles ciblent l'adaptation à un type spécifique d'événement extrême, il est important d'assurer l'échange d'apprentissages inter et transdisciplinaires entre les narrations.

Nous cherchons un chercheur pour appuyer la coordination et l'intégration de plusieurs histoires (Stabilisation financière et chaînes d'approvisionnement; Chaleur et santé; Points de basculement du climat et changements brusques). Dans ce rôle, vous serez un expert en sciences naturelles et en recherche inter/transdisciplinaire au sein d'une équipe de chercheurs en sciences naturelles, en sciences sociales et en recherche transdisciplinaire.

Vous participerez au programme NCCR CLIM+ et bénéficierez de son vaste échange et de sa formation en recherche interdisciplinaire et transdisciplinaire. Vous publierez vos résultats dans des revues scientifiques et les présenterez lors de conférences nationales et internationales.

La première phase de ce poste est prévue pour une durée de 3,5 ans, à compter du 1er novembre 2026 ou après accord. La durée du contrat est d'un an à la fois, avec possibilité de renouvellement. Le salaire suit les règlements de Zurich. Un emploi à temps partiel (p. ex. 80 %) peut être envisagé dans le cas de soins à l'enfance ou à la famille, ou d'autres projets ou emplois.

Profil

Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences du climat, en sciences de l'environnement, en météorologie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié. Vous avez de l'expérience dans la recherche interdisciplinaire ou transdisciplinaire et êtes désireux de vous engager pleinement dans les deux. Vous êtes motivé à co-développer les outils et les plateformes d'échange nécessaires. L'expérience de la modélisation du climat et du traitement des données des modèles climatiques, de l'attribution du climat et des projections climatiques, ainsi que des incidences financières et sanitaires des changements climatiques et/ou des points de basculement climatique mondial est un atout. Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes enthousiastes et dévouées ayant de très bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais. Le commandement de l'une des langues nationales suisses est souhaité. Le poste peut être pourvu au niveau postdoctoral junior ou supérieur. Ce poste est particulièrement intéressant pour les chercheurs postdoctoraux qui cherchent une carrière à l'interface entre les sciences du climat, les politiques et la société, et qui souhaitent assumer des responsabilités de coordination.

Lieu de travail

Nous offrons

• Un travail avec impact : le NCCR CLIM+ soutient votre perfectionnement professionnel et contribue à un changement positif dans la société

• Des conditions de travail flexibles dans un environnement de recherche international inspirant

• Tâches variées à l'interface de la science, des politiques et de la société

• Une équipe engagée et solidaire

• Conférences, ateliers et possibilités de formation

• Possibilités d'élargir votre réseau et d'acquérir une expérience précieuse en leadership universitaire et en développement de projets
